device.description: Choose the Christmas lights to set up.

group.description: A group has its own settings. Every change is sent to all lights in the group, and lights that connect are given the settings of the group. A group can have up to {max} sets of lights.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}? Make sure the lights are switched on and the Lights App on your phone is closed.

reconfigure.description: Change the name of the group and the lights that are in it. The group keeps its settings; lights that are added get them. A group can have up to {max} sets of lights.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Make sure the lights are in range and not connected to your phone.
error.no_members: Choose at least one set of lights.
error.too_many_members: A group can have at most 4 sets of lights.

abort.reconfigure_lights: Only a group can be changed here. The options of a set of lights are under Configure.

data_description.stay_connected: Keep the Bluetooth connection to the lights open. Turn this off to leave the lights free for the phone app, or to free up a connection on a Bluetooth proxy. Home Assistant then only connects to send a command and to read the state every 5 minutes, so commands take a little longer.

set_modes.name: Set modes
set_modes.description: Lets the lights cycle through one or more modes, like a mix of modes in the phone app.

device_not_found.message: Could not find the Christmas lights with address {address}

communication_error.message: Could not send the command to the Christmas lights: {error}

unknown_effect.message: {effect} is not an effect of the Christmas lights. Choose one of: {effects}

timers_unknown.message: The timers of the Christmas lights have not been read yet
